text: This reefer carries vaccines to Singapore.
It's at five point two degrees.
Its lenders can't see that. They see paperwork.
Daniel runs a credit fund. He'd finance the shipment, but he gets an invoice, not the container.
So he lends blind, or not at all.
The Asian Development Bank puts the trade finance gap at two and a half trillion dollars.
CargoFlow lets the cargo's own sensor evidence decide how much capital is available.
On Monad, milestone by milestone.
Meera registers the shipment and its policy. Daniel escrows the facility in USDC, paid out in milestones.
The reefer's logger signs every reading. CargoFlow fuses the probes and scores each epoch out of a hundred.
Off Sri Lanka, probe one climbs to eleven point seven degrees. The score falls to forty-eight, and the facility pauses.
Once probe two has fresh readings in band, a zero-knowledge proof, checked by the contract, resumes it.
Wei Lin pays once. Daniel is repaid with his fee, Meera gets the rest, and the bill of lading moves with the money.
New on Monad: Cargo Notes.
Daniel's position is now an asset, marked on chain to the cargo's latest evidence.
Undrawn cash counts at par. The drawn part is discounted as the score falls, and more while paused.
Asks and bids meet on an order book. A trade moves the note, and settlement pays whoever holds it.
With four-hundred-millisecond blocks, every mark stays live.
This is the live app on Monad testnet.
The fleet. A settled shipment, with every epoch, release, pause and proof linked to its transaction.
The Cargo Notes page reads the chain every block: an active note at its mark, a paused one with its haircut.
Below, a note wrapped as a token trades on Kuru, and every fill is indexed by Envio.
On MonadVision: the proof that resumed the facility, and the settlement that paid the note holder.
An AI agent can trade notes too.
Our MetaMask Agent Wallet plugin refuses a paused note, then buys an active one after the owner approves by email.
On Kuru, the wrapped note gets its own spot market, and a market buy fills on chain.
Envio's HyperIndex serves the market history, and Alchemy is the primary Monad RPC behind the API.
Eleven contracts, source-verified. Three hundred seventy-nine contract tests.
CargoFlow. Capital that moves with your cargo.
